title: Head of Sales (m/w/d)
description:
Introduction

Auf einen Blick

  • Player-Coach-Rolle: Du führst ein Team aus 4 SDRs und AEs UND verantwortest selbst eigene Enterprise-Deals
  • Fokus auf gehobenen Mittelstand & Enterprise ab 1.000+ Mitarbeitenden
  • OTE 130.000-200.000 €, Bonus uncapped, quartalsweise ausgezahlt
  • Direkte Berichtslinie an den Gründer/CEO, enge Zusammenarbeit auf Augenhöhe
  • Kunden wie Deutsche Bahn, AOK, ADAC und Rossmann
  • Hybrid: Deutschlandweit möglich, mit regelmäßiger Präsenz in Frankfurt. Rhein-Main-Gebiet bevorzugt, aber auch von anderswo in Deutschland machbar, wenn regelmäßige Reisen realistisch sind (z. B. einmal pro Woche oder alle zwei Wochen mit Übernachtung)
  • AI-first: Claude für alle, Freiraum für eigene Automatisierungen in deinem Team

About The Role And Potential Progression

Für wen dieser Job nicht ist

  • Wenn du nur noch führen willst und keine Lust mehr auf eigene Deals hast, ist das nicht die richtige Rolle. Wir glauben, dass man ein Team nur führen kann, wenn man selbst in der Tiefe versteht, was es tut.
  • Wenn du Teamaktivität mit Ergebnis verwechselst (viele Calls, wenig Abschluss), wirst du hier nicht glücklich.
  • Wenn dir Politik, Status und lange Freigabeschleifen wichtig sind, bist du hier falsch. Wir sind knapp 50 Leute und entscheiden schnell.

Wenn du bis hier gelesen hast und denkst "genau mein Ding", weiter geht's.

Worum es geht

Du übernimmst die Leitung und die systematische Weiterentwicklung unseres B2B-SaaS-Enterprise-Neukundenvertriebs, und bleibst dabei selbst vertrieblich aktiv. Du führst ein vier-köpfiges Sales Team und verantwortest gleichzeitig eigene Deals mit Fokus auf gehobenen Mittelstand und Enterprise. Unsere Kunden sind Namen wie die Deutsche Bahn, AOK, ADAC und Rossmann, und das Thema (Wissen & KI im Unternehmen) hat gerade enormen Rückenwind.

Du berichtest direkt an Sebastian (Gründer/CEO) und bist sein unmittelbarer kommerzieller Sparringspartner: schnelles Feedback, direkte Wege, keine Umwege über drei Ebenen.

Deine ersten 90 Tage

  • Woche 1-2: Onboarding in Produkt, ICP, Buying-Center-Logik, CRM/Framework; Kennenlernen des Teams (SDRs und AEs) und laufender Deals; Shadowing bei Discovery Calls und Demos
  • Ab Woche 2/3: Erste eigene Discovery Calls und Team-1:1s; Review der bestehenden Pipeline und Prozesse
  • Ab Monat 2: Eigene Pipeline im Aufbau, erste Anpassungen an Team-Setup oder Prozessen
  • Ab Monat 3: Erste eigene Abschlüsse, klare Roadmap für Teamausbau und -entwicklung

What's in it for you

  • Vergütung: OTE 130.000-200.000 €, Split flexibel je nach Erfahrung/Präferenz, Bonus uncapped und quartalsweise ausgezahlt
  • Entwicklungsweg: Konkrete Perspektive auf Head of Sales oder vergleichbare Führungsrolle mit wachsendem Verantwortungsbereich
  • Direkter Zugang zur Führung: Kurze Wege zum Gründer, schnelles Feedback
  • Stabilität ohne Investorendruck: Wir sind profitabel, bootstrapped, wachsen aus eigener Kraft, keine kurzfristige Exit-Logik
  • Namhafte Referenzen: Deutsche Bahn, AOK, ADAC, Rossmann und weitere
  • AI-first ab Tag 1: Claude für das ganze Team, aktiv im Arbeitsalltag
  • Choose your own device: Windows oder Mac, deine Entscheidung
  • Arbeitsmodus: Hybrides Modell mit 2-3 Tagen Onsite im Office Frankfurt, flexibel gestaltbar bei weiterer Distanz

How you can make an impact

  • Gesamtverantwortung im Neukundenvertrieb: Zielerreichung, Budgetplanung, Controlling und Optimierung auf Basis relevanter Sales-KPIs
  • Team-Aufbau und Führung: Du führst und entwickelst dein Team aus 4 SDRs und AEs, coachst hands-on und bist nah an den Deals deines Teams, nicht nur am Dashboard
  • Eigene Pipeline: Du führst eigene Enterprise-Deals eigenständig von Discovery bis Abschluss, mit MEDDIC als Werkzeug, nicht als Pflichtübung
  • Vertriebsteamoptimierung: Du richtest Team, Methodik und Playbooks an unserer Positionierung aus und schärfst sie, während der Bereich wächst
  • Strategische Konzeption: Du initiierst Vertriebskonzepte und -kooperationen zum Aufbau zusätzlicher Vertriebskanäle
  • Kontinuierliche Analyse: Du analysierst Team, Prozesse und Markt, um den Vertrieb an sich verändernde Anforderungen anzupassen
  • Repräsentation: Du repräsentierst Omnora auf Messen und Veranstaltungen

Skills to be successful

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Neukundenakquise komplexer B2B-SaaS-Lösungen mit Fokus auf Enterprise-Kunden, mit nachweisbarem Track Record als Closing AE
  • Erfahrung im Aufbau, der Führung und Motivation von Vertriebsteams (idealerweise SDRs und AEs gemeinsam geführt)
  • Erfahrung mit strukturierten Sales-Frameworks (MEDDIC, Challenger, SPICED)
  • Erfahrung im C-Level-/Bereichsleiter-Umfeld
  • Stabile Tenure: 2+ Jahre in aktuellen bzw. letzten Rollen
  • Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und Englisch in Wort und Schrift

Mindset, das zu uns passt:

  • Du übernimmst Verantwortung für die Ergebnisse deines Teams UND deine eigenen, statt Gründe zu suchen
  • Hunter-Mentalität: Du treibst Outbound aktiv, sourcst gerne selbst statt nur bestehenden Leads zu folgen
  • Du weißt, wann du Prozess und Headcount ergänzt, und wann du bewusst schlank bleibst
  • Du willst in den nächsten 12-18 Monaten eine steile Lernkurve, für dich und dein Team
  • Klare Worte sind dir wichtiger als diplomatischer Nebel, auch uns gegenüber
  • Du greifst aktiv zu KI-Tools und baust dir eigene Automatisierungen

Your path to Omnora

  1. Kennenlernen mit unserer Senior Talent Acquisition Managerin
  2. Deep Dive mit dem Fachbereich
  3. Kennenlernen mit unserem Gründer & CEO
  4. Onsite Assessment inkl. Case Study und Team Meet-Ups

title: Senior Performance Marketing Manager – Performance Marketing, MMM & AI (m/w/d)
description:
Du hast den kompletten Performance-Marketing-Mix fest im Griff und nutzt KI im Kampagnenmanagement nicht als Hype, sondern als tägliches Werkzeug? Du möchtest datengetriebene Entscheidungen zur Budgetallokation treffen und aktiv mitgestalten, wie modernste AI-Tools die Steuerung im E-Commerce revolutionieren? Dann wartet in unserem Team in Berlin deine nächste große Challenge auf dich: Bei benuta übernimmst du echte Ownership über unsere Kanäle hinweg und treibst ein echtes Greenfield-Thema voran – die Skalierung KI-gestützter Analysen und Strategien für den europäischen Marktführer im Home-&-Living-Bereich!


Deine Aufgaben

  • Strategische Kanal- & Budgetsteuerung: Du entwickelst und verantwortest die kanalübergreifende Performance-Marketing-Strategie via MMM zur Erreichung unserer Unternehmensziele (Umsatz, Effizienz, Lead-Gen, Brand Awareness). Du steuerst und optimierst Kampagnen über Google Ads, Bing Ads, Meta, Pinterest, Reddit Ads sowie Affiliate-Partnerschaften mit einer konsistenten Budget- und Ziellogik.

  • AI-Integration & Workflow-Innovation: Du treibst den Einsatz von LLMs (z. B. Claude, Gemini) für die automatisierte, kanalübergreifende Analyse unserer Kampagnendaten aktiv voran. Du entwickelst Prompts und Workflows für beschleunigtes Reporting, Anomalie-Erkennung sowie Budget-Optimierungen und agierst als interner Expert für KI-gestützte Marketing-Tools.

  • Analyse & Bidding-Evaluierung: Du überwachst und analysierst alle relevanten KPIs (CPO, ROAS, CAC, Conversion Rate) auf Basis von GA4 und unserem serverseitigen Tracking-Setup (server-side GTM). Zudem bewertest du KI-gestützte Bidding- und Automatisierungsfunktionen der Werbeplattformen auf ihren Mehrwert.

  • Tracking-Setup & Datensicherheit: Du implementierst und verwaltest Tracking-Setups (z. B. Conversion-APIs, UTM-Konventionen) und stellst eine saubere, datenschutzkonforme Datengrundlage sicher.

  • Testing: Du verantwortest fortlaufende A/B-Tests und Budget-Experimente zur kontinuierlichen Performance-Steigerung aller Kanäle.

  • Partner-Management & Kollaboration: Du verhandelst und entwickelst Vendor- und Partnerverträge (z. B. im Affiliate-Bereich) weiter. Bei der Kampagnenabstimmung arbeitest du eng mit den Teams aus Design, Content und IT zusammen.

  • Mentoring: Du unterstützt bei der fachlichen Anleitung sowie dem Onboarding von Junior-Kolleg*innen im Team und teilst dein KI-Wissen.


Dein Profil

  • Ausbildung: Du hast dein Studium (BWL, Marketing, Medien, Kommunikationswissenschaften o. Ä.) erfolgreich abgeschlossen oder bringst eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit.

  • Relevante Berufserfahrung: Du bringst mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung im Performance Marketing mit – idealerweise kanalübergreifend (SEA, Paid Social, Affiliate) und mit nachweisbarer Budget- oder Teilprojektverantwortung. Erste Erfahrung in der fachlichen Führung ist von Vorteil.

  • AI-Expertise (Must-have): Du besitzt praxiserprobte Erfahrung im Einsatz von KI-Tools und LLMs im Marketing-Kontext (z. B. Prompting für Reporting, Analysen, Forecasting). Du verfolgst aktuelle AI-Trends aktiv und brennst darauf, diese bei benuta einzubringen.

  • Hard Skills: Du zeichnest dich durch ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten aus, nutzt GA4 sowie gängige Attributions-/Reporting-Tools souverän und hast tiefe Kenntnisse in mindestens einem Zentralkanal (Google Ads, Meta). Erfahrung mit Bing, Pinterest, Reddit, Affiliate und serverseitigem Tracking runden dein Profil ab.

  • Soft Skills: Du arbeitest datengetrieben, denkst lösungsorientiert und begeisterst dich für E-Commerce sowie die Themen Home & Living.

  • Sprachkompetenz: Deine Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse sind sehr gut (weitere Sprachen sind ein Plus).

Deine Benefits

  • Impact & Gestaltungsspielraum: Bei uns kannst du aktiv mitgestalten, die Marke benuta weiterentwickeln und spannende KI-Projekte umsetzen – wie etwa den Aufbau KI-gestützter Analyse-Workflows für unsere Kampagnendaten. Deine Ideen werden gehört und du bekommst Freiraum für die Umsetzung eigener Ansätze.

  • Präsenz & Flexibilität: Der Schwerpunkt unserer Arbeit liegt auf dem persönlichen Austausch und der gemeinsamen Zusammenarbeit vor Ort an unserem Standort in Berlin. Für die nötige Flexibilität in deiner Alltagsplanung - sei es für private Termine oder ungestörtes Arbeiten - bieten wir dir ein jährliches Kontingent von 26 Home-Office-Tagen.

  • Deine Mobilität: Egal wie du zu uns kommst, wir unterstützen dich. Du hast die Wahl zwischen einem vergünstigten Jobticket oder einer Tankkarte. Zudem bieten wir dir ein Firmenrad-Leasing (JobRad) und eine gute ÖPNV-Anbindung.

  • Zeit für Erholung: Du erhältst 28 Tage Urlaub und profitierst von unserem flexiblen Gleitzeitmodell. Weihnachten und Silvester sind bei uns grundsätzlich arbeitsfreie Tage, die nicht von deinem Urlaubskonto abgehen.

  • Deine Entwicklung: Unsere unterschiedlichen Abteilungen mit internationalen Teams arbeiten an vielfältigen Projekten zusammen. Dadurch lernst Du permanent neue Sichtweisen, Tools und Prozesse kennen – inklusive aktuellster KI-Anwendungen im Performance Marketing.

  • Kultur & Mitarbeitervorteile: Ein strukturiertes Onboarding, flache Hierarchien und attraktive Mitarbeiterrabatte warten auf dich. Bei uns gilt: Come as you are – fühl dich wohl und sei einfach du selbst!

Klingt nach deinem nächsten Match? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung! Lade einfach deinen Lebenslauf und deine relevanten Zeugnisse über unser Online-Portal hoch.

Dein Ansprechpartner ist Michael Stanke (Head of Online Marketing).

*Bei uns zählt der Mensch und seine Motivation - unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Religion oder sexueller Orientierung. Bewerbungen von Menschen mit einer Schwerbehinderung oder ihnen Gleichgestellten werden bei gleicher Eignung bevorzugt berücksichtigt.

Über benuta

title: Cloud Engineer - Quantum Computing (m/w/d)
description:
eleQtron develops and operates full-stack quantum computers based on trapped-ion technology. Quantum computing is a new computing paradigm rapidly approaching commercial viability. Our unique approach combines laser-cooled trapped ions with microwave control and tailored magnetic fields. Our next-generation computing machines under development will be able to find solutions to problems that are out of reach today, thus enabling new innovative products and services for a brighter future.

We are looking for a Cloud Engineer (m/f/d) to join us in Hamburg or Siegen and build and operate the scalable, secure cloud platform that connects users with our trapped-ion quantum computers.

Responsibilities:

You will join our Quantum firmware Team as a Cloud Engineer. You will build the layer through which the world reaches our quantum computers. Users submit quantum programs; your services compile, schedule, and dispatch them to our machines and return the results:  

  • Build and operate the cloud services that let users submit quantum programs to our systems and retrieve their results.

  • Develop and deploy our compilation pipeline as a scalable cloud service , from circuit input through transpilation down to hardware-level instructions

  • Design and maintain the public API and SDK entry points to our platform 

  • Implement job queuing, scheduling, and dispatch towards the hardware backends, including quota, prioritisation, and result handling 

  • Own authentication and authorisation across the platform: user and tenant identity, API keys and tokens, and role-based access to machines, jobs, and results, built on an established identity provider rather than from scratch

  • Guarantee tenant isolation, so that quantum programs and results are never visible across customer boundaries, and manage secrets and credentials across the stack

  • Work with the quantum firmware and hardware teams on the interfaces between cloud services and the machine itself

  • Instrument the platform for observability and keep an eye on latency, throughput, and cost


Required Skills:

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience building and deploying backend or platform services in production

  • Strong Python; additional systems-level language experience (Go, Rust, C++) is welcome

  • Solid API design skills (REST and/or gRPC) for services other developers have to use

  • Practical experience implementing authentication and authorisation in production systems: OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect, token handling, and role-based access control

  • Secure engineering habits: least privilege by default, proper secrets management, and awareness of dependency and container supply-chain risks

  • Infrastructure as code (Terraform, Pulumi, or similar) and CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, or similar)

  • Working understanding of GDPR and data residency requirements, and a genuine interest in digital sovereignty

  • Ability to collaborate effectively with experimental physicists and engineers

  • Strong adaptability and a quick learning mindset

  • Good proficiency in English (written and spoken); German is an advantage for working with public-sector partners

Nice to have (Bonus)

  • Running an identity provider in production (Keycloak, Zitadel, Ory, Authentik, or a managed IAM service)

  • Multi-tenant isolation patterns in SaaS platforms

  • Contributing to security certification work (ISO 27001, BSI IT-Grundschutz, BSI C5) or acting on penetration test findings

  • Familiarity with quantum SDKs and toolchains (Qiskit, Cirq, PennyLane, QIR) or hardware abstraction interfaces such as QDMI

  • Batch scheduling or HPC environments (Slurm or similar)

  • Observability stacks such as Prometheus, Grafana, or OpenTelemetry

Millions of people live with urological and gynecological conditions they nevertalk about. We are here to end that silence. title: Performance Marketing Manager / Meta Ads (m/w/d)
description:
Wer sind wir?

Entstanden sind wir aus Deutschlands größter Finanzbildungsorganisation. Über 250.000 jungen Menschen haben wir gezeigt, wie Finanzen wirklich funktionieren. Aus dieser Mission ist Finanzklar entstanden. Denn Wissen allein reicht nicht – die meisten Menschen scheitern nicht am Verstehen, sondern an der Umsetzung.

Genau hier setzen wir an: Wir helfen ganz konkret dabei, die richtigen Finanzentscheidungen zu treffen. Ohne Provisionslogik gegen den Kunden. Ohne undurchsichtige Produkte. Sondern mit echter, unabhängiger Beratung.

Unsere Mission: Gute Finanzentscheidungen dürfen nicht länger nur den Experten überlassen sein – wir demokratisieren sie.

Und dafür suchen wir dich. Als Performance Marketing Manager (m/w/d) entscheidest du mit darüber, ob Menschen Finanzklar überhaupt kennenlernen. Wir suchen dafür jemanden, der nicht einfach Anzeigen schaltet, sondern versteht warum manche Kampagnen Menschen bewegen und andere nicht.

Aufgaben

Du planst, schaltest und optimierst unsere Meta-Ads-Kampagnen – von der Zielgruppe über das Budget bis zur täglichen Auswertung der Zahlen. Parallel entwickelst du die Creatives dazu: Anzeigenbilder, Videos und Texte, die unsere Botschaft transportieren. Du bringst zwei Dinge zusammen: Du analysierst Zahlen und verstehst, was sie bedeuten – und du entwickelst daraus Bilder und Texte, die Menschen wirklich ansprechen. Deine Aufgaben im Detail:

  • Eigenständige Planung, Aufbau und Steuerung von Meta Ads Kampagnen (Facebook & Instagram) – von der Strategie bis zur Umsetzung
  • Verwaltung und Optimierung von Werbebudgets mit klarem Fokus auf messbaren Ergebnissen (CPL, CTR, ROAS)
  • Entwicklung von Kampagnenstrategien auf Basis von Zielgruppenanalysen und Marktbeobachtung
  • Erstellung und Weiterentwicklung von Ad-Creatives – statisch und videobasiert – eigenständig oder in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Team
  • Strukturiertes Testing von Zielgruppen, Creatives, Botschaften und Landingpages nach klarer Testlogik
  • Regelmäßige Analyse der Kampagnenergebnisse und Ableitung konkreter Optimierungsmaßnahmen
  • Erstellung verständlicher KPI-Reportings zur internen Auswertung und Weiterentwicklung der Strategie
  • Aktive Mitgestaltung der Gesamtmarketingstrategie von Finanzklar

Qualifikation

Stellenanforderungen – was du mitbringst

Fachlich:

  • Analytisches Denkvermögen – du erkennst Muster in Zahlen, ziehst logische Schlüsse und kannst Daten in Entscheidungen übersetzen
  • Grundverständnis für digitales Marketing und Social Media – du weißt wie Plattformen wie Facebook und Instagram funktionieren
  • Affinität zu digitalen Tools und Systemen – neue Software erschließt du dir schnell und eigenständig
  • Erste Erfahrungen mit Meta Ads, Google Ads oder vergleichbaren Plattformen sind ein Plus – kein Muss
  • Meta Blueprint Zertifizierung von Vorteil – aber kein Ausschlusskriterium
  • Sauberes, fehlerfreies Deutsch in Wort und Schrift – Pflicht

Kreativ:

  • Gespür für visuelle Wirkung – du erkennst was Menschen anspricht und was nicht
  • Fähigkeit, Werbebotschaften klar und zielgruppengerecht zu formulieren
  • Grundkenntnisse in Design- oder Videotools (z.B. Canva, Adobe Express, CapCut) von Vorteil – oder die Bereitschaft, sie zu erlernen
  • Interesse an Storytelling und der Frage warum bestimmte Inhalte funktionieren und andere nicht

Persönlich:

  • Hohe Eigenmotivation – du treibst dich selbst an, auch wenn niemand nachfragt
  • Schnelle Auffassungsgabe und Lernbereitschaft – du bist bereit, in kurzer Zeit viel aufzunehmen und anzuwenden
  • Strukturierte und gewissenhafte Arbeitsweise – du arbeitest präzise, dokumentierst sauber und hältst dich an definierte Prozesse
  • Offenheit für Feedback und Bereitschaft zur kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung
  • Teamfähigkeit – du arbeitest eng mit Geschäftsführung und Team zusammen und kommunizierst proaktiv

Vorerfahrung im Performance Marketing Management ist ein Plus – aber kein Muss. Entscheidend ist wer du als Mensch bist, nicht was auf deinem Lebenslauf steht.

Benefits

Was du bekommst

  • Intensives Onboarding über ca. 6 Monate – du wirst hier wirklich aufgebaut, nicht ins kalte Wasser geworfen
  • Attraktives Fixgehalt plus variable Bonusvergütung bei Zielerreichung – dein Einsatz wird direkt belohnt
  • Einen Arbeitsplatz in Mannheim in einem Team das wächst, direkt kommuniziert und zusammenhält
  • Homeoffice ist nach entsprechender Einarbeitung möglich – wir besprechen das gemeinsam
  • Echte Entwicklungsperspektive: wer hier gut wird, übernimmt wachsende Budgetverantwortung und gestaltet die Marketingstrategie aktiv mit
  • Vollzeit oder Teilzeit – wir finden gemeinsam das Modell das passt
  • Ein Unternehmen mit echter Mission – du hilfst Menschen, bessere finanzielle Entscheidungen zu treffen

title: Projektingenieur / Techniker Luftfahrttechnik (m/w/d)
description:
Sie möchten technische Projekte nicht nur am Bildschirm bearbeiten, sondern deren Umsetzung von der ersten Anfrage bis zur Fertigstellung begleiten? Dann unterstützen Sie unseren Projektverantwortlichen bei anspruchsvollen Projekten im Luftfahrtbereich und bringen Sie Ihre konstruktiven und technischen Fähigkeiten bei uns ein.

Aufgaben

  • Sie unterstützen den Projektverantwortlichen bei der Planung, Koordination und Umsetzung unserer Projekte im Luftfahrtbereich.
    Sie wirken bei Ausschreibungen mit, prüfen technische Anforderungen und bereiten die erforderlichen Unterlagen auf.
  • Sie bewerten Kundenanfragen hinsichtlich ihrer technischen Machbarkeit und entwickeln geeignete Lösungskonzepte.
  • Sie erstellen und bearbeiten 3D-Modelle, technische Zeichnungen sowie Fertigungs- und Projektdokumentationen.
  • Sie ermitteln den erforderlichen Material-, Fertigungs- und Arbeitsaufwand.
  • Sie unterstützen bei der Kalkulation und Erstellung technischer Angebote.
  • Sie stimmen technische Anforderungen und offene Fragen mit Kunden, Lieferanten, dem Projektverantwortlichen sowie unseren internen Fachbereichen ab.
  • Sie begleiten die Projekte von der Anfrage über die Konstruktion und Fertigung bis zur Abnahme und Fertigstellung.
  • Sie unterstützen unsere Werkstatt bei technischen Fragestellungen während der praktischen Umsetzung.
  • Sie behalten Termine, technische Anforderungen und den jeweiligen Projektstand im Blick.
  • Sie dokumentieren Änderungen und technische Entscheidungen nachvollziehbar.

Qualifikation

  • Sie verfügen über ein abgeschlossenes Studium im Maschinenbau, in der Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik, Konstruktionstechnik oder einer vergleichbaren technischen Fachrichtung.
  • Alternativ verfügen Sie über eine Weiterbildung zum staatlich geprüften Techniker, beispielsweise im Maschinenbau oder in der Konstruktionstechnik, und bringen entsprechende Berufserfahrung mit.
  • Sie haben Erfahrung in der Konstruktion und im Erstellen technischer Zeichnungen.
  • Sie sind mit einem modernen 3D-CAD-System vertraut.

Customer Director
description:
Why Faculty?


We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

About the team

Bringing medicine to patients is complex, expensive and high-risk. Faculty’s Life Science’s team is concentrated on building AI solutions which optimise the research and commercialisation of life-changing therapies.

We partner with major pharma firms, academic research centres and MedTech start-ups to design and deliver solutions which address critical healthcare challenges, and help to democratize health for all.

About the role

As a Customer Director, you’ll play an influential role in growing our most impactful accounts.

You will act as a strategic partner to our Life Sciences clients, helping them supercharge their operations and end-user engagement through AI-powered decision-making. Leading a high-performing team of delivery and engagement specialists, you’ll oversee complex commercial negotiations, ensure the successful delivery of cutting-edge Applied AI solutions, and build key relationships which position Faculty as the global leader in AI-driven transformation.

#LI-PRIO

What you'll be doing

  • Driving revenue growth; identifying strategic opportunities to expand current accounts and onboarding new clients within your sector

  • Developing and implementing robust strategic account plans that align Faculty’s AI solutions with client business objectives

  • Leading commercial negotiations and partnering with the Business Unit Director on accurate sales planning and forecasting

  • Building trusted relationships with senior budget holders and C-suite stakeholders to ensure high levels of client satisfaction and retention

  • Managing and mentoring cross-functional commercial teams

  • Representing Faculty at industry events and networking forums to build a reputation as a thought leader in AI-driven transformation

  • Collaborating with technical teams to translate complex data concepts into innovative use cases that solve real-world client problems


Who we're looking for

  • You’ve managed senior, complex stakeholder relationships in the Life Sciences industry - some experience in consulting preferred

  • You have experience leading large-scale AI/digital transformation projects

  • You possess a strong business development mindset with experience in sales methodologies and the end-to-end management of deal processes

  • You are a practical problem solver with the forensic skills to scope a problem, identify client needs and implement effective solutions

  • You are a compelling communicator - comfortable collaborating with technical experts and translating data-oriented concepts for non-technical audiences.

  • You bring experience in team mentorship and coaching

  • You have demonstrated capability to balance multiple strategic projects simultaneously, while maintaining a focus on quality and commercial impact

Our interview process

  1. Talent Team Screen: 40 mins

  2. Introduction Interview: 60 mins

  3. Commercial Interview: 60 mins

  4. Leadership and Principles interview: 60 mins

  5. Meet the MD, Commercial: 30 mins

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.

A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI.

title: Tech Lead
description:
MyEdSpace is an education technology platform that connects the best teachers on the planet with the students who need them the most - wherever they are, whatever their means.

Backed by $15m in Series A funding from some of the leading investors in the space, we're ready to scale - and we want you to help us build and scale MyEdSpace as part of a collaborative and ambitious team.

We're on a mission to make a world-class education accessible to all.

We believe that every child deserves access to quality education, regardless of geography or socioeconomic background, to achieve their dreams and build a brighter future.

If you’re motivated by solving meaningful problems and creating real impact through your work on a societal level and make a real impact on the world - we’d love to hear from you!

Job Title: Tech Lead

Experience: 8+ years commercial experience as a Software Engineer

Location: Remote / Flexible (UK timezone overlap required)

Compensation: Competitive + bonus upside

Your Impact at MyEdSpace

We’re looking for a Tech Lead who cares deeply about building great products and well-structured systems — whether your strengths lie in backend, frontend, or across the stack. You’ll guide technical decisions, help navigate trade-offs, and support engineers in delivering high-quality work.

The role spans three key areas of responsibility:

  • Technical leadership — coding, pair programming, peer reviews, and driving software and architecture design.

  • People management — running 1:1s, supporting career progression, and ensuring a strong feedback loop.

  • Product collaboration — working closely with product and design to shape scope, prioritise effectively, and align on outcomes.

We're building both the system and the team that will take us to the next stage — and you'll have real influence on how we scale, structure, and evolve our technology.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Lead and mentor a globally distributed team of engineers, fostering a high-performance, inclusive, and collaborative culture.

  • Set the bar for technical excellence, promoting best practices across architecture, CI/CD, testing, and code quality.

  • Drive a DevOps mindset — engineers own what they build, from design to deployment and beyond.

  • Architect and deliver scalable, maintainable systems and features with measurable impact on learners.

  • Collaborate with AI specialists to integrate adaptive, personalized learning into our platform.

  • Partner cross-functionally with product, design, and data to shape roadmap, scope work, and align on outcomes.

  • Continuously improve how we build software — from delivery speed and reliability to team workflows and technical decision-making.

What We’re Looking For

  • Senior engineering experience in product-led, fast-paced environments — ideally with time spent leading teams or large projects.

  • Strong software architecture skills — API-first, modular design, async comms, scaling patterns.

  • You work AI-first: LLMs and agentic tools are part of your daily workflow, not an experiment.

  • Experience across the stack — deep backend expertise and comfort navigating modern frontend frameworks (React.js preferred).

  • Fluency in Agile and Lean methodologies, you think in terms of shipping value in small increments, not running ceremonies.

  • Comfortable working in Docker-based, cloud-native environments (we use AWS).

  • A track record of shipping user-facing products that are performant, elegant, and thoughtfully engineered.

  • Excellent communication skills and collaborative mindset — you're comfortable working across disciplines and time zones.

Perks & Benefits

  • Flexible working hours

  • Competitive compensation with significant upside

  • Access to the latest AI tools & productivity software

  • Global, mission-driven team with a strong sense of purpose

Our Hiring Process

We aim to keep the process efficient, transparent, and focused on mutual fit:

  1. CV Screening

    We review your experience, technical foundation, and alignment with the role.

  2. Introductory Call with Hiring Manager

    A 60 minute conversation to discuss your background, what you're looking for, and how we work.

  3. Coding Exercise

    A take-home designed to assess practical skills — architecture, clean code, testing, and problem-solving.

  4. Technical Interview

    A deep dive into your engineering approach — we’ll explore past projects, technical decisions, and systems thinking.

  5. Culture & Collaboration Interview

    A final conversation to assess team fit, communication style, and alignment with our values and ways of working with the Product Manager of the squad

✨ Our values

PUT INTEGRITY FIRST Honesty matters. Tell the truth, and be straight-up. Be transparent and do the right thing. This builds respect and reliability for our students, families and team members.

KNOW YOUR COORDINATES Understand where you are and where you want to get to. Know your strengths and acknowledge your gaps. Think from first principles. Question things, and never pretend to know what you don't.

RAISE THE BAR Own it and get it done. Do better. Iterate quickly and seek feedback. Deliver real value. Be excellent and lift others up. Share learnings and help your teammates improve.

LOVE TO BE WRONG Push boundaries. Be outside your comfort zone. Naturally you'll get some things wrong and that's okay. Embrace feedback. Learn from it and get closer to excellence.

WIN TOGETHER To achieve our mission, we have to work together. We all have a role to play, so help each other get there. We’re stronger as a team so inspire, support and respect each other.

🙋 Why you’ll love working here

We’re a team on a mission to transform education for the better. Joining MES means you’ll be part of something ambitious, fast-moving, and full of purpose. Here’s what you can expect:

  • The chance to make a real impact: your work directly shapes the future of education.

  • A fast-paced and high-growth environment where ideas move quickly and careers accelerate.

  • A collaborative, supportive culture: we’re head quartered in the UK, but we’re a global team with colleagues in 15+ countries, bringing a rich mix of perspectives and energy.

We are committed to building a diverse team and strongly encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds. We believe diverse perspectives make us stronger and help us build a better product for students around the world.

title: Staff Product Manager
description:
V7

At V7, we’re building AI platforms that help humans do their best work, at incredible scale and speed. Our mission is to turn human knowledge into trustworthy AI, making complex tasks faster, smarter, and more accurate. We’re growing fast, backed by leading investors and AI pioneers (including the minds behind Transformers and Gemini).

The product

V7 Go is a set of tools for the document-heavy work that finance and insurance teams do every day. Workflow automation for the processes that used to eat whole afternoons. A Context Graph that makes everything a team knows (across workflows, documents and integrations) queryable in one place. Chat for the questions that don’t fit a process. It takes multi-modal data and returns verifiable outputs with transparent logic, so accuracy and compliance come built in, and it runs on the latest models including GPT, Claude and Gemini.

The point isn’t the AI. It’s that an analyst who used to spend three days on something gets it back in an hour, with citations and an audit trail, and can show their working to anyone who asks. Have a look at what we’re building for finance and insurance.

The team you’ll be joining and the impact you’ll have

  • You’ll own V7 Go. That’s the whole product, not a corner of it, working with [X] engineers and [X] designers and with the founders close by.

  • Go 4x-ed revenue last year with 160%+ upsell, and we’re running tens of millions of documents through it for customers in finance, insurance and real estate. What you choose to build next is what decides where that goes.

  • The product does a lot of different things for a lot of different teams. A big part of the job is having a view on what it should be, and being willing to say no to the rest.

  • It’s a small product team, so there’s not much process to hide behind. If something’s broken or missing, it’s yours to sort out.

What you’ll be doing from day one

  • Owning the roadmap. Deciding what gets built, killing the stuff that doesn’t matter, and shipping continuously rather than in quarterly chunks.

  • Working out which problems are actually worth solving. Sales wants one thing, the loudest customer wants another, and the interesting bet is usually neither.

  • Defining what good looks like before anything gets built, then checking afterwards whether it landed. Adoption, not shipped tickets.

  • Making the trade-off calls. What’s in, what’s out, what’s deliberately a bit rubbish for now, and being able to explain why to whoever asks.

  • Writing things down clearly. Decisions, trade-offs, why we said no to something. It’s how a small team stays pointed the same way.

  • Keeping the whole thing coherent. Workflows, Context Graph and chat need to feel like one product rather than three that happen to share a login. Most of the features are self-serve, so if it needs explaining, that's a product problem.

Who you are

  • You’ve owned a product properly, at a startup or somewhere with a serious product culture. Not running a backlog someone else set.

  • You've owned a real product area end to end at a startup or a company with a serious product culture. Discovery through launch, not backlog management.

  • You've built for expert users who know their domain better than you do. B2B SaaS, fintech, insurtech, developer tools, data platforms.

  • You're genuinely hands-on with LLMs and agents. You build with them, you have views on what they're good and bad at, and you can tell a demo from a product.

  • You can hold a conversation with engineers about trade-offs without needing everything translated.

  • You’re happy without much certainty. Priorities move here more than they would somewhere bigger.

  • Opinionated but not precious about it.

V7 champions equality and inclusion because diverse teams build better products. Don't check every box? Apply anyway — we value what makes you unique and will support you through the process, just let our Talent team know how they can help.

Compensation: £100K – £140K • Offers Equity

We ensure financial stability and support our business partners in decision-making.


Finance sits within our Enablement function, providing the expertise, structure and challenge that help loveholidays operate at its best. Through clear frameworks, trusted partnerships and practical guidance, we support better decisions, manage risk and create strong foundations for sustainable growth.

Your day-to-day:

Partner with wider business stakeholders to drive strategic insights, identify variance drivers for working capital, and provide data-driven recommendations that influence decision-making.

  • Cash & Liquidity Management: Manage daily cash operations, including liquidity monitoring, and investment activities to maximise returns and reduce idle cash. Drive the end-to-end process for the 13-week cash flow forecast - from gathering inputs and analysing variances to refining assumptions, ensuring high-confidence projections for senior management.

  • Risk Exposure: Actively manage financial risk in the business, including FX, counterparty, and interest rates.

  • Process Innovation & Automation: Champion continuous improvement by identifying manual tasks across Finance and Treasury. Drive automation projects — to streamline processes, improve data integrity, and create scalable workflows, while training our shared service centre to take on operational day to day responsibilities.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Serve as a bridge between your team and the wider Finance team, ensuring seamless communication and supporting ad-hoc financial projects that align with company-wide business and growth goals.


Your skillset:

  • Qualified Accountant (minimum 2+ years post qual)

  • You have: a background in commercial finance with interest in developing Treasury exposure, or a background in Treasury and interest in wider commercial finance

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

  • Proven experience using AI to accelerate delivery and improve efficiency

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

  • Proficient in financial modelling, budgeting and forecasting

  • Excellent stakeholder management experience

  • Organised, task focused and will go the extra mile to get things done

The interview journey:

  1. Intro with a member of the Talent Acquisition team - 30 mins

  2. 1st Stage with Assistant Treasurer - 45mins

  3. 2nd Stage with Head of Treasury and a member of Finance Leadership Team - with case study and presentation - 1 hour

  4. 3rd Stage with VP of Commercial Finance / VP of Group Finance - 30 mins

Perks of joining us:

  • Company pension contributions at 5%

  • Individualised training budget for you to learn on the job and level yourself up

  • Discounted holidays for you, your family and friends

  • 25 days of holidays per annum (plus 8 public holidays) increases by 1 day for every second year of service, up to a maximum 30 days per annum

  • Ability to buy and sell annual leave

  • Access to our electric vehicle salary sacrifice scheme

  • Cycle to work scheme, season ticket loan and eye care vouchers

 

Our commitment to inclusion:

At loveholidays, we focus on creating an inclusive environment where everyone can contribute, grow and succeed. We value the different perspectives, experiences and ideas each person brings, because they help us work better together, challenge our thinking and make stronger decisions.

As we continue to grow and evolve, we want everyone to feel supported and able to do their best work. We’re also committed to making our hiring process accessible, so please let our Talent Acquisition team know if you need any adjustments at any stage.

SENIOR CONSULTANT  

London

Hybrid - Onsite 3 – 5 days  

Permanent  

Role Summary  

This is a fantastic opportunity to join our fast-growing Consulting Business working with some of the world’s leading financial institutions.  

As a  Senior Consultant, the successful candidate will work directly with our clients to ensure they receive the quality consulting services that Delta Capita (DC) offers. The ideal candidate will have a good understanding of financial services, exceptional problem-solving skills, project management and/or business analysis experience, the ability to manage, motivate and inspire others, and a proven track record of delivering successful client engagements. You will have change management experience and prior success as a senior consultant or within a change role in a financial services institution.  

To know more about our Consulting services, click here Consulting - Delta Capita.  


The Role and Responsibilities  

This role is ideal for someone with the right mix of consulting and client management experience as well as having an entrepreneurial spirit. You will combine project delivery know-how, a can-do attitude, and a strong knowledge of and network within the financial services industry.  

Project responsibilities include;  

  • Management of client relationships, building and maintaining strong relationships with key project stakeholders and client accounts. Act as a trusted advisor, demonstrating an understanding of their evolving needs, proactively identifying new opportunities for collaboration within Consulting and across the broader firm (e.g., Services).  

  • Support Project Managers and Business Analysts, ensuring high quality delivery throughout the project lifecycle. Provide guidance and mentorship to more junior consultants, fostering their professional growth and development. Lead by example, promoting a collaborative and innovative work culture in line with DC’s values.  

  • Collaborate with the Sales and Marketing teams and Consulting leadership to support the development of campaigns, respond to RFPs, and contribute to the growth of DC’s Consulting practice.  

  • Contribute to internal initiatives and support the development of consulting expertise. Contribute to knowledge sharing sessions, client events, thought leadership articles, whitepapers, presentations, and industry conferences.  

  • Propose ideas for continuous improvement and operational excellence. Identifying opportunities to enhance existing processes to optimise efficiency and develop DC IP.  

As an experienced Senior Consultant, you will have:  

  • Proven Consulting experience or alternatively in Project Management or Business Analysis within Financial Services.  

  • Change management experience: Strategy, Design, Analysis, Project Management, Build Testing, Go-Live.  

  • Understanding of Financial Services products and lifecycle events.  

  • Some experience managing small projects, supporting successful project/programme deliveries.  

  • Good knowledge of the capital markets eco-system and participants. E.g., sell side, buy side, market infrastructure, etc.  

  • You will come from a management consultant background or within a change role in a financial services institution. You must have a blend of both Financial Services knowledge and soft skills across influence, listening, presentation and team management.  

  • You will be expected to be comfortable working on an independent basis and managing your own workload with minimal supervision.  

  • You will also be responsible for helping to grow our business by supporting ongoing operations and RFPs.

It would be great if you had knowledge of any of the following:  

  • Experience of working in financial services regulation  

  • Experience of working in an agile environment with Agile certifications  

  • Experience of working across technology and system upgrades  

How We Work:  

Delta Capita is an equal opportunity employer. We positively encourage applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of age, colour, disability, national origin, ancestry, race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, veteran status, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable law.  
  
We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. If you require any reasonable adjustments through your interview process, please use the designated space within the application questionnaire.  

This is a permanent full-time position located in London. As the selection and interview process is ongoing, please submit your application in English as soon as possible, if your profile is selected, a member of our team will contact you within 4 weeks. For this role, a valid working permit for the UK is mandatory.  

Expectations regarding hybrid working: As we are a Service Provider and Consulting firm servicing clients, our policy for physically working from the office (which may be the clients' offices or our own offices depending on the client) aligns to what our clients' policies and expectations are and these vary. Most of our clients now require a minimum of 3 days per week in the office, 2 days from home, and accordingly this is also the minimum expectation that Delta Capita require. 

Who We Are:

SIMPL Business Unit — Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS)

Seyond

SIMPL is scaling its international footprint across Europe, APAC, and emerging markets, and is building out dedicated regional sales leadership to match the growth already underway in the Americas.

We are looking for a Senior Director of Sales to build and lead SIMPL's sales function across Europe — a role modeled on the regional sales leadership Seyond has already established in the Americas. You will report directly to Philip Lassner, Head of Global ITS Business, and will sit above SIMPL's country-level sales representatives across Europe, giving the region a single accountable sales leader for the first time.

  • Establish clear rep-level KPIs that balance new-business generation with existing-account growth, supported by weekly activity tracking.

  • 8+ years of B2B sales experience, ideally in ITS, smart infrastructure, industrial IoT/sensors, or another technical, tender-driven market.
  • A proven personal quota-carrying track record as an individual contributor — a genuine "hunter," not primarily an account manager or sales-ops leader.
  • Experience building or leading a distributed regional sales team, ideally spanning multiple European countries.
  • Comfort managing both channel relationships (distributors, OEMs, system integrators) and direct end-user/agency sales cycles.
  • Experience navigating public-sector or government tender processes is a strong plus.
  • Fluent English required; German or another major European language is a plus.
  • Willingness to travel extensively across Europe.

Nice to Have

  • An existing network in European traffic management, tolling, or highway agencies.
  • Experience selling LiDAR, radar, or other sensor-based detection technologies.

Competitive base and incentive package, benchmarked to Director-level sales leadership roles in the European technology/industrial sector. Final compensation band to be confirmed following market benchmarking.

description:

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl's operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

Together, you'll be shaping how sellers and brands connect, operate, and grow across multiple marketplaces worldwide.

In this role, you will directly lead 2 squads — Seller Experience and Channel Integration — representing approximately 12 engineers based between Paris, & Bordeaux, with close collaboration with colleagues based in the US.

Location: Based in Paris or Bordeaux office with one day of remote work per week.

  • Lead and develop two engineering squads responsible for the seller journey on Mirakl Connect and integrations with external marketplaces such as Amazon, Walmart, and Zalando, ensuring reliable delivery and a high engineering bar across both teams.

  • Develop your people: coach engineers and tech leads, identify growth opportunities, run performance and career conversations, and contribute to attracting strong talent into the organization.
  • Build a strong operating model for your teams — improving ways of working pragmatically, protecting team focus, fostering ownership, and enabling effective collaboration with distributed and international stakeholders.

 

What You'll Bring to the Role

Experience:

  • At least 4 to 5 years of experience managing engineering teams, with a track record of leading teams of 5 to 6 engineers or more, ideally across multiple squads.
  • Proven experience in e-commerce, marketplaces, channel management, feed management, catalog or order management — or a closely related domain.
  • A solid Java background — you may no longer be hands-on today, but you have the depth to challenge architectural decisions, assess technical trade-offs, and manage a team of Java engineers with credibility.
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver in a demanding and fast-moving environment, while protecting team focus and adapting your management approach to the existing context.
  • Experience collaborating with international and cross-functional stakeholders across time zones.

Skills:

  • Engineering leadership: ability to set direction, delegate effectively, and develop people at all levels.
  • Execution in complexity: capable of managing delivery, priorities, and trade-offs across multiple teams simultaneously.
  • Technical judgment: able to engage in Java architecture discussions, challenge integration design choices, and guide engineers on complex distributed systems.
  • Fluent English: able to lead discussions, challenge decisions, and collaborate autonomously with US-based and international partners.

 

Tech Stack

  • Java (recent versions)
  • Spring Framework
  • SQL
  • Cloud platforms
  • Microservices architecture

 

Languages

  • French: Full professional proficiency
  • English mandatory: Full professional proficiency — approximately 50% of your working time will be in English

 

Our Hiring Process

title: CENTRALE LYON - Postdoctoral Researcher Position Deep Learning for Functional-Oxide Growth Video-to-Spectrum Prediction by RHEED / XRD Fusion
description:
PROJECT OVERVIEW

We are looking for a highly motivated Postdoctoral Researcher to develop innovative deeplearning models that predict the structure of functional-oxide thin films directly from their growth dynamics. Positioned at the interface between Artificial Intelligence and materials physics, the OXYD-IA project aims to design a deep model able to predict the final X-ray Diffraction (XRD) spectrum of an oxide thin film from the sole Reflection High-Energy Electron Diffraction (RHEED) video recorded during its growth by Molecular Beam Epitaxy (MBE).

The resulting tool will open the way to predictive, in situ control of oxide epitaxy – a process today dominated by a costly trial-and-error approach, in which the structural and functional properties of the films are only validated ex situ. You will join a genuinely multidisciplinary collaboration between the INL (Institut des Nanotechnologies de Lyon), which provides the operando experimental data and materials-physics expertise, and the LIRIS (équipe Imagine), which provides the deep video-learning and probabilistic-modelling methodology – both at École Centrale de Lyon.

A high-impact opportunity. AI for experimental physics is a fast-growing field, and OXYD-IA offers a genuine first-mover advantage within it: you would work on a unique, unpublished dataset of paired RHEED videos and XRD spectra to build one of the first video-to-spectrum models with calibrated uncertainty for oxide growth. By learning directly from experimental 1 data, such a model can short-circuit the traditional trial-and-error loop, accelerate discovery and drastically cut experimental time, cost, precursor consumption and instrument occupancy – turning routine in situ diagnostics into predictive tools.

Scientific context. Epitaxial perovskite-oxide thin films exhibit rich, tunable functional properties (thermoelectricity, ferroelectricity, piezoelectricity) governed by their structure and composition, themselves correlated with the growth conditions. MBE offers independent control of each element but, applied to oxides, is notoriously unstable and poorly reproducible because of the oxidising atmosphere. RHEED tracks the surface dynamics in real time (lattice parameter, surface reconstructions, roughness) but does not give access to the final bulk microstructure, which is only reachable ex situ via XRD / XRR. There is therefore a strong physical link – so far unexploited quantitatively – between RHEED dynamics and final XRD microstructure, which OXYD-IA proposes to learn directly.

Figure 1 – OXYD-IA pipeline. At inference, the RHEED video acquired during growth (INL) feeds a deep video encoder (LIRIS) and a probabilistic regression module that predicts the final XRD spectrum together with its uncertainty. During training, the predicted spectrum is compared with the ex situ XRD / XRR spectrum measured at INL (ground truth); this discrepancy is the supervised learning signal that adjusts the model parameters.

KEY RESEARCH AREAS AND RESPONSIBILITIES

You will drive the core computational research along a risk-managed, phased 12-month roadmap. The primary target is a versioned RHEED / XRD dataset, growth-regime classification and probabilistic regression of the key structural parameters with calibrated uncertainty; full-spectrum prediction, a real-time demonstrator and cross-oxide generalisation are stretch and follow-on objectives. The work is organised around three technical pillars:

1. Corpus structuring and spatio-temporal RHEED representation • Build a versioned dataset by cleaning, temporally aligning and pairing the RHEED video sequences, the associated MBE parameters (temperature, oxygen pressure, source fluxes) and the ex situ XRD / XRR spectra (SrTiO3 reference system). • Pre-train, in a self-supervised manner, a spatio-temporal video encoder (3D CNN, e.g. R(2+1)D, or temporal Vision Transformer) fine-tuned on the laboratory corpus. • Perform fuzzy / Bayesian classification of the growth regimes (2D vs. 3D modes, transitions, RHEED oscillations), building on LIRIS expertise in the statistical analysis of sequences.

2. Probabilistic RHEED →XRD regression with uncertainty quantification • Design a latent representation that couples the video encoding with the physical MBE parameters. • Learn stepwise – first scalar structural parameters (lattice parameter, density, mosaicity), more robust at small N, then the full 1D XRD spectrum. • Provide calibrated uncertainty estimates (Bayesian approaches or deep ensembles), indispensable for guiding real-time decisions during growth.

3. Real-time demonstrator and dissemination (stretch / follow-on) • Validate the model on new SrTiO3 growths and prototype an in-growth inference tool at the end of the NANOFUTUR MBE line. • Mitigate the small-data and generalisation challenges through temporal data augmentation, transfer learning from pre-trained video encoders and domain adaptation towards other functional oxides. • Contribute toward a high-impact joint publication at the AI / materials interface (the project milestone is the submission of a joint paper).


REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• A Ph.D. in the field of Artificial Intelligence – Computer Science, Machine Learning, Computer Vision or Signal Processing, and we are looking for a senior postdoc with 2–5 years of post-PhD experience.

• Deep learning on sequential / video data: demonstrable, hands-on experience with 3D CNNs, temporal transformers and / or probabilistic models. Proficiency in Python and PyTorch (or TensorFlow) is mandatory.

• A genuine appetite for physics: a strong curiosity for, or prior exposure to, experimental physics and materials science. The ideal candidate carried out an AI-focused Ph.D. and is eager to apply it to a real materials-physics problem.

• Research mindset: a track record of innovation and the ability to work autonomously on a complex, multidisciplinary project. • Software skills: experience with Git version control and reproducible research.

• Excellent communication and scientific-writing skills in English.

ADDITIONAL SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES

• Self-supervised video pre-training, uncertainty quantification (Bayesian / ensembles), fuzzy classification, or domain adaptation.

• Experience with small-sample / transfer-learning settings and handling large-scale experimental datasets.

HOW TO APPLY

Please prepare a single PDF file containing:

1. A detailed Curriculum Vitae, including a list of publications.

2. A 1-page motivation letter explaining your specific interest in this project and how your background addresses the key responsibilities and qualifications listed above.

3. The names and contact information of at least two academic references.

title: Director, Business Development
description:
About TransPerfect

TransPerfect is the world's largest privately held provider of language services and technology solutions. With over 100 offices globally and more than 5,000 full-time employees, we work with the world's leading organisations across Legal, Corporate, Life Sciences, Financial, and Creative sectors to help them communicate, operate, and grow across languages, cultures, and markets.

 

Following our acquisition of The Mill — one of the world's most acclaimed creative studios — TransPerfect now offers an expanded suite of creative production services, including Artistic Direction, VFX, and Motion Design, serving luxury, fashion, beauty, and lifestyle brands globally.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Director of Business Development to join our Corporate vertical in France. This is a pure new business hunter role — your mission is to identify, prospect, and close net new accounts across TransPerfect's full portfolio of services.

You will be selling into mid-to-large corporate accounts across a broad range of industries, with a particular focus on sectors where TransPerfect's expanded capabilities — including creative production via The Mill — create strong differentiation and cross-sell opportunity.

This role is ideal for a commercially driven professional who combines structured B2B sales discipline with genuine curiosity about creative, digital, and linguistic services.

What You Will Sell

You will represent TransPerfect's full Corporate service portfolio, including:

  • Translation & Localisation** — documents, marketing, legal, technical, and digital content

  • Interpretation** — simultaneous, consecutive, remote (RSI)

  • Technology & AI Solutions** — GlobalLink TMS, MT/MTPE, AI-powered workflows

  • Digital & Multimedia** — subtitling, dubbing, voice-over, e-learning localisation

  • Creative Production (The Mill)** — Artistic Direction, VFX, Motion Design for luxury, fashion, beauty, and lifestyle brands

  • Globalisation Consulting** — content strategy, workflow optimisation, language asset management

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and manage a pipeline of net new business across the French and European corporate market

  • Identify and engage key decision-makers — CMOs, Heads of Communication, Procurement Directors, Creative Directors, and Heads of Production

  • Develop tailored pitches and proposals that draw on the full breadth of TransPerfect's service offering, including creative capabilities

  • Lead the full sales cycle from prospecting to close, including RFP/RFI responses, commercial negotiation, and contract finalisation

  • Collaborate with internal teams (Solutions, Operations, The Mill creative teams) to design compelling, client-specific solutions

  • Represent TransPerfect at industry events, trade shows, and networking forums

  • Contribute to market intelligence — identify trends, competitor movements, and emerging client needs

  • Report pipeline, forecast, and activity accurately


Experience

  • Minimum 3–7 years of B2B sales experience, with a strong track record in new business development

  • Experience selling , multi-service solutions to corporate clients — ideally in one or more of the following: creative services, digital production, marketing services, SaaS/tech, or professional services

  • Proven ability to close six-figure deals and manage multi-stakeholder, long-cycle sales processes

  • Exposure to or genuine interest in creative industries (luxury, fashion, beauty, lifestyle, advertising) — a strong differentiator

  • Experience navigating large organisations — identifying budget holders, managing procurement processes, and building internal champions

 

Skills & Competencies

  • Hunter profile— proactive, autonomous, energised by opening new doors

  • Ability to sell both transactional and strategic engagements depending on client maturity

  • Strong discovery and consultative selling skills— listens before pitching

  • Comfortable discussing technology, AI, and workflow solutions as well as creative services

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills in both French and English

  • Commercially rigorous — accurate pipeline management, disciplined forecasting

 

Languages

  • French — native or bilingual (essential)

  • English — fluent, business-level (essential)

  • Additional languages a plus

 

Education

  • Degree in **Business, Marketing, Communications, Languages, or a creative discipline** — or equivalent professional experience

title: Associate Director, Medical Affairs
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Associate Director, Medical Affairs based in France.

As Associate Director, Medical Affairs, you will serve as a scientific leader and subject-matter expert across a broad range of Medical Affairs activities. You will independently lead high-value workstreams spanning thought leader engagement, scientific congresses, medical communications, publications, literature surveillance, and insight generation. The role combines external scientific engagement with strategic ownership of programs that support the product lifecycle. You will translate clinical evidence and stakeholder insights into practical recommendations that shape Medical Affairs priorities. You will also collaborate closely with cross-functional teams and provide trained backup support for selected Pharmacovigilance, Medical Information, and Product Complaint activities. This is a remote opportunity within a purpose-driven, collaborative healthcare environment, with approximately 20% travel for congresses and external engagements.


Accountabilities

  • Serve as a scientific subject-matter expert, translating clinical evidence, stakeholder insights, and emerging scientific developments into balanced, actionable recommendations for Medical Affairs strategy.

  • Develop and maintain compliant relationships with key thought leaders (KTLs), healthcare professionals, and other external scientific experts.

  • Plan and conduct scientific exchanges, advisory boards, roundtables, consensus initiatives, and other external engagements aligned with Medical Affairs objectives.

  • Develop KTL engagement plans, define interaction objectives, document scientific insights, and coordinate appropriate follow-up with Medical Affairs leadership.

  • Provide scientific coverage at national and selected regional congresses, including program assessment, session prioritization, coverage planning, KTL preparation, insight capture, and post-congress reporting.

  • Lead the scientific strategy and execution of Medical Affairs booths, including educational content, scientific exchange, medical inquiry routing, insight collection, and post-congress analysis.

  • Partner with Medical Affairs Operations on congress logistics, vendors, contracts, and budget administration.

  • Lead or support scientific communications, including medical education materials, congress resources, presentations, standard response letters, FAQs, and other non-promotional materials.

  • Support publication activities such as publication planning, literature reviews, abstracts, posters, manuscripts, and white papers in accordance with applicable governance processes.

  • Conduct literature surveillance and synthesize relevant scientific, clinical, safety, and competitive developments, identifying implications for evidence generation, education, and stakeholder engagement.

  • Aggregate and analyze insights from KTL interactions, congresses, advisory boards, Medical Information, surveys, and research activities to identify evidence gaps, educational needs, stakeholder barriers, and strategic opportunities.

  • Represent Medical Affairs on cross-functional teams and provide scientific expertise to Regulatory, Quality, Commercial, and other internal stakeholders as appropriate.

  • Serve as a trained and designated backup for defined Pharmacovigilance, Medical Information, and Product Complaint activities, including medical inquiry review or escalation, safety information escalation, and selected product complaint assessments.

  • Support continuous improvement across Medical Affairs processes while maintaining high standards of scientific quality, compliance, and risk management.

    • Requirements

    • Advanced scientific or healthcare degree such as a PharmD, PhD, MD, DO, or another relevant advanced degree.

    • Four or more years of relevant pharmaceutical industry experience preferred, including experience within Medical Affairs.

    • Strong scientific and clinical acumen, including knowledge of medical terminology, clinical study design, biostatistics, evidence appraisal, and interpretation of clinical and real-world evidence.

    • Demonstrated ability to critically evaluate and synthesize complex scientific, clinical, safety, and technical information and translate findings into clear, balanced recommendations.

    • Strong scientific writing and communication capabilities, including experience developing medical education materials, evidence summaries, abstracts, posters, manuscripts, presentations, and other scientific content.

    • Working knowledge of publication standards, copyright requirements, scientific exchange principles, and applicable Medical Affairs laws, regulations, industry guidance, and internal requirements.

    • Ability to establish credible and compliant relationships with KTLs, healthcare professionals, and external scientific experts.

    • Strong presentation skills and the ability to adapt complex scientific information for scientific, executive, and cross-functional audiences.

    • Strategic thinking, sound judgment, and the ability to connect scientific evidence and stakeholder insights with broader Medical Affairs priorities.

    • Demonstrated ability to collaborate and influence cross-functional stakeholders while maintaining appropriate Medical Affairs independence.

    • Strong project and program management skills, including the ability to manage multiple priorities, complex workstreams, and time-sensitive deliverables.

    • Ability to aggregate and synthesize insights to identify evidence gaps, educational needs, stakeholder barriers, and strategic opportunities.

    • Strong awareness of quality, compliance, and risk, including the ability to recognize and appropriately escalate safety, product quality, and compliance information.

    • Prior experience in Pharmacovigilance, Medical Information, or product complaints is preferred; the ability to complete role-based training and provide designated backup support is required.

    • Experience with KTL engagement, scientific exchange, congress planning or coverage, and scientific communications is preferred.

    • Strong organizational, stakeholder-management, communication, and presentation skills.

    • High degree of accountability, adaptability, integrity, discretion, and commitment to continuous improvement.

    • Ability to work independently within a lean, cross-functional environment and exercise sound judgment when managing competing priorities and potential risks.

    • Fluent English communication skills and willingness to travel overnight up to approximately 20%, including for scientific congresses and external stakeholder engagements.

    • Flexibility to occasionally work evenings or weekends when required by congress schedules or external engagements.

      • Benefits

      • Competitive base salary range of $150,000–$180,000, depending on experience, education, skills, and geographic location.

      • Eligibility for an annual performance bonus.

      • Comprehensive employee benefits package.

      • Remote working arrangement.

      • Approximately 20% travel, providing opportunities for scientific congress participation and external stakeholder engagement.

      • Opportunity to take visible ownership of high-impact Medical Affairs programs.

      • Exposure to scientific strategy, evidence generation, external engagement, and the full product lifecycle.

      • Opportunity to work alongside experienced professionals in a collaborative, purpose-driven healthcare environment.

      • Meaningful opportunity to contribute to the development and support of potentially life-saving healthcare products.

      • Strong scope for scientific leadership, cross-functional influence, and professional growth.

title: Director – International Relations and Diplomacy Programs
description:
Your mission

The Director of International Relations and Diplomacy (IRD) Programs, based at the Paris Campus, will provide academic leadership for Schiller International University’s undergraduate, graduate and online International Relations and Diplomacy programs across all campuses. The Director will be responsible for ensuring program currency and curriculum quality, faculty hiring and performance, and achieving student outcomes within the International Relations and Diplomacy discipline. In addition, the Director will provide Academic Leadership at the Paris Campus for all academic programs.

The director will also work with academic team, student experience and data team to monitor key performance indicators and help design interventions to ensure achieving student outcomes set by the university.
  
 In collaboration with Associate Deans, Directors of other academic areas, and the Paris Campus Director, the Director of International Relations and Diplomacy Programs will provide academic leadership for the Paris Campus and oversee faculty hiring and management, course allocations and academic operation.

  • Lead International Relations and Diplomacy programs design, review, and continuous improvement in collaboration with Academic team and other university offices.

  • Assess instructional needs and lead the effort to identify, hire and assign qualified faculty to all International Relations and Diplomacy courses across campuses in collaboration academic leaders on other campuses in a timely manner.
  • Collaborate with academic leaders on other campuses to identify, hire and assign qualified faculty to all courses on the Paris campus in a timely manner.
  • Lead annual evaluations of faculty in IRD across campuses and contribute to faculty annual performance evaluations at the Paris campus.

  • Manage faculty workload and faculty assignment in collaboration with the other academic leaders.

🤖 Who we are

Alan Clinic. A health companion and a digital clinic for everyone.

We're a small team within Alan, on a mission to redefine the future of care by democratizing access to medical expertise. The Clinic is two crews building one experience:

  • Mo. An intelligent, empathetic, multimodal LLM-based conversational AI assistant able to prescribe, triage, and proactively follow up on care. We kicked off in 2023 and launched Mo to all our French members (1M) in Q1 2026, making it the first safe AI health companion live at scale in Europe.

  • Clinic Platform. The medical services behind the conversation: chat with health practitioners, teleconsultation, and care programs across primary care, mental health, and physiotherapy.

Imagine giving every person in the world instant, 24/7 access to personalised medical expertise (through chat, voice, or video) with AI agents working in tandem with real doctors and the health system. That's what we are building 🤖🏥.

🚀 What you'll build and who you'll work with

We're building a medical experience that works reliably, safely, and at scale. An AI agent, and the clinic behind it. You'll lead the engineering team and you'll keep building alongside them.

The crews work at the intersection of product engineering, ML engineering, and medical expertise. As their engineering leader, you own:

  • 💬 The team behind the most memorable chatting experience. Hiring, onboarding, honest feedback, and the mix of skills Mo needs as it grows. Talent density is yours to own.

  • ➕ The architecture for Mo's next chapters. More context, new skills, new countries. You guide the calls on our architecture and agentic framework, and you stay close enough to the code to make them well.

  • 🏥 The platform that turns conversations into care. Chat with health practitioners, teleconsultation at national scale, and the tooling doctors and therapists use every day. You drive alignment with the crews and medical teams on the other side, so members get from words to actions.

  • 🛡️ Operational excellence. Mo and teleconsultation are real-time services that have to be live 24/7. Latency, error rates, incident response, and an on-call rotation that doesn't burn people out.

If you're excited by the idea of building the future of healthcare, this is the team for you. We're at the start of the journey. If you're curious, here is a paper we published recently.

⚡ Why this role is special

  • Dual impact: Shape both technical excellence and team growth - your engineers become better while building better products

  • Leadership growth: Influence engineering culture, mentor future leaders, and drive technical strategy that shapes the future of healthcare delivery

  • Startup speed, Alan's platform. Mo operates with the focus of a startup, on top of Alan's infrastructure, distribution, and health expertise. Small team, huge reach.

  • Stakes that make the work matter. In medical AI, reliability and safety are the product. Every call you make on quality, architecture, and evaluation is a call about our members' health.

🔍 What we're looking for

We're looking for an engineering leader who gets excited about building state-of-the-art AI systems and applying them to real-world, high-stakes problems in healthcare.

Leadership experience

  • 3+ years leading engineering teams, with a track record of building high performers.

  • You partner with other product functions as a true equal: you shape the roadmap, name trade-offs honestly, and help the team commit to what it can actually deliver.

Technical foundations

  • Experience establishing engineering excellence standards, with the ability to guide architectural decisions.

  • First-hand experience shipping AI or LLM products to production is a big plus.

  • You're excited and eager to keep writing code. You still review it, and you still ship some yourself.

  • Comfortable with modern development practices and AI-assisted development tools.

  • Curious, self-starting, humble, collaborative, and eager to grow.

  • You develop people as much as you develop products.

  • Ex-founders are typically a great fit in our team.

  • Healthcare technology and innovation excite you
